callstack_attribution.method: Inclusive ancestry shares from weighted perf-script periods over target benchmark blocks; matching block intersections are explicit.

limits: No perf counter, stack share, or syscall row isolates a single transaction or operation.
perf stat and perf record are separate whole-process invocations; their cycle totals must not be subtracted or expected to match.
The no-children report rows are self/leaf overhead percentages; inclusive marker shares overlap and are not additive.
perf record retained zero lost samples, but restricted kernel address maps leave some kernel frames unresolved.
strace includes startup, oracles, report serialization and teardown; its write time does not establish a sink syscall bottleneck.
The profile covers only the normal binary at count 131072 and does not establish formal timing, allocator behavior, or a speedup claim.

measurement_controls: retain the accepted normal binary, source snapshot, count, route, warmup and sample shape
separate setup/oracle ancestry from measured lifecycle ancestry using matching sample blocks
preserve XML/member/semantic validation proofs and unchanged-member checks
treat any result as diagnostic until rerun under the formal protocol
next_measured_work.selection: Run phase-attributed measurements for repeated XML scanning/layout and bounded replay/validation paths next.

report.interpretation: Top rows are self/leaf overhead from perf report --no-children; callchain annotations are sampled ancestry shares and overlap.

script.marker_method: A marker counts once per target sample block when any resolved frame contains it. Lifecycle intersections use matching block identities; marker shares are inclusive and overlap.

report.interpretation: Top rows are self/leaf overhead from perf report --no-children; callchain annotations are sampled ancestry shares and overlap.

materialized.report_stderr_warning_limit: Kernel address maps are restricted in retained perf-record stderr; some kernel frames may remain unresolved. User binary symbols in perf report remain retained.

script.marker_method: A marker counts once per target sample block when any resolved frame contains it. Lifecycle intersections use matching block identities; marker shares are inclusive and overlap.

perf_stat.comparison_limit: Counters are from separate profiler workload invocations; bounded/materialized ratios are descriptive whole-process ratios, not operation-only attribution.
